question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

The teacher explained the concept in a __concise__ way, making it easy to understand.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Brief**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"concise"** means expressing much in a few words; clear and succinct. (संक्षिप्त)

 
 
• **Example:** The report was concise, making it easy for everyone to understand.
 
 
 
• **"Brief"** means short in duration, length, or extent; succinct and to the point. (संक्षिप्त)
 
 
• **Example:** The manager gave a brief overview of the project during the meeting.
 
 
 
• Both "concise" and "brief" have similar meanings, as they refer to something that is expressed in a short and clear manner.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Brief**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Confusing** (भ्रमित करने वाला): Something that causes uncertainty or lack of clarity.

 
 
• **Example:** The confusing instructions made it difficult to assemble the furniture.
 
 
 
• **Interesting** (रोचक): Something that captures attention or arouses curiosity.
 
 
• **Example:** The documentary was so interesting that I couldn’t take my eyes off the screen.
 
 
 
• **Detailed** (विस्तृत): Something that includes many specific facts or features.
 
 
• **Example:** The report provided a detailed analysis of the market trends.
